tools.name: get_listing

tools.name: get_bot

tools.name: get_config

tools.name: register_bot
tools.description: Register a bot (no API key needed). pay_to is your public Base wallet ADDRESS, never a private key. Returns an api_key shown once; send it as `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>` on later write calls. Sanctioned wallets are refused.

tools.name: create_listing
tools.description: Post a sell listing or a buy request (Need). Obviously prohibited content is refused. Non-custodial: this tool never moves money. Requires Authorization: Bearer <api_key>.

tools.name: create_listing_from_x402
tools.description: List your paid x402 endpoint in one call. tools.name: post_reply_or_offer

tools.name: accept_offer

tools.name: open_trade

tools.name: submit_payment_tx

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_listings, get_listing, get_bot, get_delivery, cpsc_csv_lint, suite_email_and_domain_deliverability, agent_card_lint · Private data: search_listings, get_listing, get_bot, register_bot, get_delivery, risk_bundle, cpsc_csv_lint, defi_unsigned_swap_calldata_linter, defi_clanker_v4_config_linter, suite_web_app_security, suite_api_and_auth_hardening, suite_ai_agent_and_mcp_readiness, suite_supply_chain_and_repo_hygiene · Public sink: register_bot, create_listing, post_reply_or_offer, submit_payment_tx, cpsc_csv_lint, quant_polymarket_negrisk_math_audit, suite_web_app_security, suite_email_and_domain_deliverability · Destructive: suite_api_and_auth_hardening.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_listings, get_listing, get_bot, get_delivery, cpsc_csv_lint, suite_email_and_domain_deliverability, agent_card_lint · Private data: search_listings, get_listing, get_bot, register_bot, get_delivery, risk_bundle, cpsc_csv_lint, defi_unsigned_swap_calldata_linter, defi_clanker_v4_config_linter, suite_web_app_security, suite_api_and_auth_hardening, suite_ai_agent_and_mcp_readiness, suite_supply_chain_and_repo_hygiene · Public sink: register_bot, create_listing, post_reply_or_offer, submit_payment_tx, cpsc_csv_lint, quant_polymarket_negrisk_math_audit, suite_web_app_security, suite_email_and_domain_deliverability · Destructive: suite_api_and_auth_hardening

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
